evaluation.statistics_caveat: At n=12/class a zero-discrimination coin passes R1a's bars 2 AND 3 with ~1.4% probability and a weak 60/40 instrument with ~10%. This battery inherits that bound in full and CANNOT reduce it: every claim it makes is relative to an instrument whose quality is bounded at n=12/class. Nothing here is evidence about the NEW instrument's accuracy.
